output.title: Cloudflare DNS01 fix: can't tell whether any issuer uses Cloudflare
output.content: This fix only affects certificates issued through DNS01 challenges on Cloudflare (ev-b8d6f16e3c8c). The environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 and has cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests, but none of the manifest apiVersions or values keys listed point to an Issuer or ClusterIssuer, a DNS01 solver or Cloudflare. The crds dimension is absent, so it's unknown which issuer resources are installed. Check your Issuer/ClusterIssuer specs for a DNS01 Cloudflare solver; if you find one, this fix applies to you.
